_about: GM plan and position. Never rendered. Prose for beats, quests and roads lives in saga/bible/_gm/arc.md (saga.py arc <id>); this file holds state. Edit through saga.py plan where a command exists; otherwise with Edit, keeping the canonical format (saga.py fmt).
book_question: Who is hollowing the wounded, and can a knight who cannot stand protect anyone?

chapter.question: When the Confessor reads his list at the gate, does sanctuary hold, and does Darrow stand up to be counted or stay among the wounded?

slots.plan: Scene 1, The Reading of the Knots: first snow; Maelis reads the two Knots; the soft season named; the Steps forbidden a fourteenth time
Scene 1 (continued): Hollis on the next cot, the far cots, Wren counting; the House before the news
Scene 1 (continued): Wren brings the list from Coldmere: six grey cloaks, a cart, a censer; Hollis second; who is first
Scene 1 (end): the Reckoning wakes at the window; Maelis unsurprised: 'So it's begun.' 'Close the door, Captain.'

They go from the hall doorway to a cell down the hall and shut it (Hollis, in the hall, sees them go). Behind the cell door, straight from 'Close the door': Maelis explains the Reckoning and the Ember in as few words as she can; the Wardens were burned for it; she forbids him to tell anyone, Hollis most of all; she does not explain her own past; told from inside the cell, and it ends on the latch lifting, by Darrow's hand or hers: the same instant the Interlude ended on, seen from the other side (the Interlude has already shown the door opening from Hollis's side)

Mother Ione's council: sanctuary, Old Mercy, the rule of the bell at dawn and dusk; Sister Pell is old; Rae Thorne at the council as the one who heard the list read (her cart and oxen stand at the winch-house, in the grey cloaks' path); afterwards she asks Darrow, flat, whether he rode a grey at the ford, and does not say why

options: "If Old Mercy rings, it rings for a man who will never kneel again, not for the House's sake either. Decide knowing it."
"Tell the lay brothers the Faithless went down the far side a week ago. Let the valley carry it."

slots.plan: The grey cloaks reach the foot of the Steps; censer smoke rising through the cloud; the House counts what it has; Rae on the gate wall beside Darrow as the grey cloaks reach the winch-house and put a man on her cart; she could go down past them and does not, yet
The Wax: Hollis and the writ he broke without looking; Benedek Orrin on the next cot asks what second on the list means; the paper goes unread into the cup of the wooden leg

world_moves: the kitchen has started counting loaves
Sister Pell rang the dusk bell late, and someone noticed
a grey cloak has put his boots up on Rae Thorne's cart at the winch-house

climax.plan: Marrant at the gate. He reads the writ; Mother Ione has Old Mercy rung; sanctuary holds. Marrant smiles and makes camp in the lower court: 'Bells grow tired.' Darrow's confrontation with him (Insight / Resolve; Warden's Eye applies). Choice at the end: step forward and answer to his name, stay hidden among the wounded, or send Wren to spy on the Confessors' camp. A grey cloak stays at the winch-house with his boots on Rae Thorne's cart: the cage, the House's larder and letter-box, is in the Order's hand (q1.cart).
options: Step forward and answer to his name
Send Wren to spy on the camp *[Guile 1]*

q1.hollownight.note: pin to the week of real Halloween if Book I is still open

ash.note: the hound in the kennels; snarls at everyone else; appears in q1.kennel or in t1

rae.note: the carter of the last cart (Prologue, revised 10/9) and named in Chapter 1; arrives as a companion when q1.cart stage 3 is written (she stays past the dusk bell); --pending until then

quest_summary: Confessor Ivo Marrant is coming up the Holloway with six men, a censer, and a writ naming the Faithless at Saint Ysolde's. Darrow's name is first; Hollis is second. Rae Thorne, the carter who heard the list read, is in the House; her cart and oxen wait at the winch-house below, where the Confessors will camp first.
